exposure.needed: whether the environment runs the standalone User Operator with TLS not needed and without the Cluster CA cert Secret (the evidence names no chart values, environment variables or Secret name identifying this configuration)

original.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 updates the standalone User Operator so that it handles the Cluster CA certificate Secret being missing when TLS is not needed.

decision.reason: [ev-35ea1afad43d] is a single changelog line. It says the standalone User Operator now handles a missing Cluster CA cert Secret when TLS is not needed. It names no Helm value, CLI flag, environment variable or Secret name that would let an engine tell when TLS is not needed or when the Secret is absent. An undecidable exposure with reason release-knowledge-gap fits this. P4's condition (a --mode=standalone flag and a TLS_ENABLED env var) uses names that do not appear in the evidence.
